name: Osmaura
long_description:
We surface new client, cross selling, upselling opportunities that a firm is well positioned to take advantage of. We manage the client experience from sourcing to onboarding to future matters.

We're here to help law firms grow and care for their clients while they focus on what they do best. Lawyers are trained to practice law - not to prospect, sell, and manage clients.

launches.title: Osmaura: AI growth engine for law firms
launches.tagline: We help law firms find new clients
launches.body:
Osmaura helps law firms find new clients.

Most law firms still rely almost entirely on referrals to grow. But referrals are unpredictable and can’t reliably bring firms the specific types of clients they want.

Osmaura gives law firms AI agents that understand their work, discover & monitor legal-specific data sources to spot demand for their expertise, and run thoughtful outreach.

<https://youtu.be/ut9tL383BXE>

Law firms are already adopting Osmaura. In four weeks, we went from $0 to $14K MRR.

Businesses with fewer than 500 employees alone spend $105 billion on legal services in the U.S. each year. Osmaura helps firms proactively pursue the work they are best positioned to win.

Founders Kali and Jity have worked across technology and public policy since high school. Kali built large-scale AI systems for legal analysis at the MIT Gov Lab, while Jity built AI infrastructure at Meta and AI developer tools at Jane Street.

If you’re a law firm looking for a more predictable way to win the right clients, reach us at founders@osmaura.com!

launches.title: Osmaura - AI agents that identify legal needs
launches.tagline: We surface new matter opportunities for law firm partners.
launches.body:
**Tl;dr:** We’re building AI agents that surfaces new matter opportunities for law firm partners.

### **The problem:**

Partners at law firms spend at least 10 hours of every week trying to win new clients. 

However, they’re limited to corporate contacts within their network. Firms try to help by connecting them with prospects but it’s often unclear which ones are ready to become clients.

### **The solution:**

AI can give partners a deeper understanding of prospective clients and legal support they might need **at the right time**.

### **What we’re building:**

Our agents monitor companies and regulators across the web to surface early signals that a company may soon need counsel and ways to connect with them.

Here’s how it works:

1. **Understand the partner**: The agents build a profile of the partner using their practice group, previous deals, and their network.
2. **Find new matters**: Then, they continually find prospective clients and potential latent legal needs using external data sources (including disclosures, product launches, customer complaints, enforcement actions, rule changes).
3. **Orchestrate outreach**: Finally, they filter for potential clients the partner is well-positioned to land, and suggest tasteful ways to engage them.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hbBDbuNP-Mw>

### **Team:**

We’re Kali and Jity, two friends from MIT who talked to a lot of partners and saw just how much pressure they’re in when it comes to originating work, especially as the legal space gets more competitive.

_Kali_ → 2x AWS Intern and ML/NLP research at MIT focused on policy prediction and argument extraction. I’ve been interested in law and public institutions for years and I bring that context to building AI for the legal industry.

_Jity_ → Experience at Meta/Jane Street, and computational astrophysics research at MIT. I'm interested in building great technical products, and have spent months learning from law firm partners to understand how they win new matters.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=104368&key=user_uploads/1366260/e72319d6-8fb3-4589-9a06-e2c255c28cf3)

### **Ask:**

If you are a corporate lawyer, know a lawyer, or are someone who thinks deeply about corporate law firm growth, we’d love to talk to you!

Reach us at [founders@osmaura.com](mailto:founders@osmaura.com) And sign up at [osmaura.com](http://osmaura.com)
